text.p: Here are the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 Plus radio station's noon news report on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Algirdas Brazauskas said he was optimistic about the NATO summit and the documents signed left a possibility for Lithuania jo join the alliance in the future.
- President Brazauskas criticised Russia's reference to Lithuania as a former Soviet republic.
- A seminar on the abolition of capital punishment in Lithuania was held in the constitutional court in Vilnius.
